name: BoonData.json
summary: Game-balance data defining selectable boons (perks), each with a code, localized name/description string keys, a 5-bit position mask, and five tunable value slots. Loaded at runtime by DataManager into boon data structures.

name: DefineData.json
summary: Global gameplay constants (define table) holding the player's default HP, default damage, and default round timer values. Loaded at runtime by DataManager as base tuning parameters.

name: DeviationData.json
summary: Game-balance data defining deviation entries (boon-shaped records with code, localized name/description keys, position mask, and five value slots) used as gameplay modifiers. Loaded at runtime by DataManager.

name: EnemyData.json
summary: Enemy roster of ten enemy types, each with a code, localized string keys, a resource/prefab name, the min/max round range in which it can appear, and three tunable value slots. Loaded at runtime by DataManager to drive enemy spawning.

name: RoundData.json
summary: Per-round difficulty curve for ten rounds, defining a cumulative round-timer delta and an enemy HP multiplier that scales from 1.0 up to 4.0. Loaded at runtime by DataManager to ramp difficulty across rounds.

name: AssetManager.cs
summary: CommonManagerBase manager that loads and caches AudioClip assets through Addressables, keyed by an audio clip enum.

name: DataManager.cs
summary: DataManagerBase manager that asynchronously loads JSON game-data tables (boon, define, deviation, enemy, round) from Addressables into typed dictionaries and exposes TryGet lookups.

name: GameData.cs
summary: Serializable data-model classes (BoonData, DefineData, DeviationData, EnemyData, RoundData) deserialized from JSON and keyed by Code, implementing IGameData.

name: InGameManager.cs
summary: SceneManagerBase scene controller driving the in-game match flow: wave timers, host setup, finger assignments, RPS outcome resolution, lives/HP tracking, and round transitions, coordinating NetworkManager, PlayerManager, and InputManager via events.

name: InGameUIManager.cs
summary: Minimal in-game UI manager stub extending UIManagerBase, serving as the registration point for in-game UI panels.

name: InputManager.cs
summary: CommonManagerBase manager reading keyboard input each frame for single- and multi-control finger modes, tracking the extended-finger mask and firing toggle/mask-change events.

name: LobbyManager.cs
summary: SceneManagerBase lobby scene controller wrapping NetworkManager session operations (create/join/quick-join/leave/start), managing ready state and display names, and refreshing lobby UI panels.

name: LobbyUIManager.cs
summary: Minimal lobby UI manager extending UIManagerBase that triggers an initial lobby UI refresh on Start.

name: ManagerBase.cs
summary: Defines the manager registration infrastructure: a static ManagerHandler that reflects App's manager fields and injects instances, plus DataManagerBase and CommonManagerBase base classes that self-register on Awake.

name: NetworkManager.cs
summary: The Photon Fusion networking hub (CommonManagerBase, INetworkRunnerCallbacks): manages NetworkRunner lifecycle, cloud connection, session create/join/start, finger-assignment sync, and round-result broadcasting over reliable data and [Networked] PlayerNetworkObject state.

name: PlayerManager.cs
summary: CommonManagerBase manager that resolves, spawns, and despawns PlayerNetworkObjects, builds lobby player snapshots, and exposes local-player accessors for the game and UI layers.

name: SceneManagerBase.cs
summary: Abstract base for per-scene managers extending CommonManagerBase, logging scene context on Awake and providing MoveToNextScene scene transitions via App.LoadScene.

name: HPBarController.cs
summary: MonoBehaviour that animates a UI HP bar by driving a delayed-drain shader fill effect on an instanced material via SetFloat.

name: LobbyCodeUtility.cs
summary: Static utility for generating, validating, and normalizing alphanumeric lobby session codes used by the Photon Fusion networking layer.

name: LobbyPlayer.cs
summary: Immutable data model snapshot of a lobby participant (id, display name, host/ready/local flags) used to render lobby UI.

name: LobbyRequestResult.cs
summary: Result wrapper for lobby operations with static Success and Fail factory helpers carrying an optional error message.

name: LobbySession.cs
summary: Mutable session-state container tracking session code, state, players, host flag, and derived readiness/fullness for the Fusion lobby.

name: PlayerNetworkObject.cs
summary: Photon Fusion NetworkBehaviour holding [Networked] per-player state (display name, ready, assigned finger, cursor, starforce result) and exposing RPCs; uses a ChangeDetector in Render to fire LobbyDataChanged/InGameDataChanged events.

name: PlayerProfile.cs
summary: Static helper persisting the local player's display name and a generated user id to PlayerPrefs, with display-name normalization.

name: EnemyHand.cs
summary: Hand subclass for the AI/enemy hand that randomly cycles RPS positions during a round via coroutine, caches HandSpriteData, and reports its position to InGameManager.

name: Finger.cs
summary: MonoBehaviour representing a single finger on a hand, toggling its open/closed sprite from FingerSpriteData via a SpriteRenderer.

name: Hand.cs
summary: Abstract base MonoBehaviour for a hand that caches its child Finger components into a lookup table and exposes finger open/close and hand-position helpers.

name: HandSpriteData.cs
summary: ScriptableObject asset holding a hand id, hand sprite, and per-finger open/closed sprites with a GetFingerSprite lookup.

name: PlayerHand.cs
summary: Hand subclass for the local player that tracks an active finger and applies finger open/closed state and masks driven by player input events.

name: ModeData.cs
summary: Tiny data holder exposing the IsSingleControl flag that selects between single- and multi-control game input modes.

name: SoundManager.cs
summary: Audio system manager handling BGM crossfading, looping SFX, and a pooled one-shot SFX source set, loading and caching clips through the asset manager.

name: TitleManager.cs
summary: Title-scene controller that validates the player nickname, connects to the photon cloud, and transitions to the lobby scene on success.

name: TitleUIManager.cs
summary: Empty UIManagerBase subclass that registers and manages the title scene's panels.

name: UIManagerBase.cs
summary: Base UI manager that registers panels by type, maintains a panel dictionary and an ESC-closeable UI stack, and exposes open/close/get helpers.

name: ForbidHandShapePanel.cs
summary: In-game panel showing rock/paper/scissors cooldown indicators with DOTween animations for dim, flash, and completion punch effects.

name: HUDPanel.cs
summary: Heads-up display panel rendering player and enemy HP bars with animated drain, ghost-follow fills, and hit-shake feedback, driven by game events.

name: IndicatePanel.cs
summary: Tooltip-style panel that shows a typed IndicateSlot following the mouse, used to display contextual name/description hints.

name: StarforceModalContent.cs
summary: Networked starforce-style timing mini-game shown inside a modal, where each player stops a moving star in a success zone synchronized via the network manager.

name: StarforceStar.cs
summary: Visual widget for a single starforce mini-game star, exposing reset, move, and stop operations on its image and rect transform.

name: ModalContent.cs
summary: Abstract base for individual modal contents, defining Activate/Deactivate hooks and an OnRequestClose event for self-driven closing.

name: ModalPanel.cs
summary: Panel that hosts registered ModalContent instances, showing one by type, blocking input while active, and closing on content request.

name: NextIconPanel.cs
summary: Panel showing the upcoming hand-position icons from a generated queue, recycling and sliding NextIconSlot widgets between positions on wave events.

name: OutcomePanel.cs
summary: Panel that displays the round outcome (win/lose/draw) with distinct DOTween animation sequences, hiding itself at the next round start.

name: StagePanel.cs
summary: Panel showing the stage map with selectable StageSlot widgets, host name, boss HP, and a cursor reflecting the host player's pointer.

name: TimerPanel.cs
summary: Panel displaying the round countdown timer and current stage label, updating via subscribed timer and stage events.

name: IndicateSlot.cs
summary: Reusable slot widget for the IndicatePanel that shows a name/description tooltip and positions itself by anchored coordinates.

name: NextIconSlot.cs
summary: Reusable icon slot widget for NextIconPanel exposing its rect transform and current hand position with a sprite setter.

name: StageSlot.cs
summary: Clickable stage selection slot that broadcasts the chosen stage to the network when its button is pressed.

name: Tooltip.cs
summary: Pointer event handler that drives the IndicatePanel to show, follow, and hide a typed tooltip as the cursor enters, moves over, and exits the element.

name: WaveSlot.cs
summary: Reusable wave indicator slot widget showing a wave ball and a defeated mark with DOTween punch/fade animations.

name: VersusPanel.cs
summary: Intro panel that plays a 'Ready / Fight' stamp DOTween sequence when opened, then auto-closes itself.

name: WavePanel.cs
summary: Panel managing the row of WaveSlot indicators, resetting them on stage open and marking the next slot defeated on a winning outcome.

name: LobbyEntryPanel.cs
summary: Lobby entry panel with create-room, join-by-code, and quick-join flows that drive the lobby manager, toggling interactability and status text during async requests.

name: LobbyPlayerListItem.cs
summary: Row widget for the lobby player list showing a player's name and ready state.

name: LobbyRoomPanel.cs
summary: Lobby room panel listing connected players via LobbyPlayerListItem rows and exposing ready/start/leave actions wired to the lobby manager.

name: PanelBase.cs
summary: Abstract base class for all UI panels, handling self-registration with the UI manager and open/close lifecycle including UI-stack push/pop. Acts as the foundational UI hub inherited by every concrete panel.

name: SlotHoverScale.cs
summary: UI behaviour that scales a slot element up on pointer hover and back on exit using DOTween animations, implementing Unity pointer event interfaces.

name: TitlePanel.cs
summary: Title-screen panel that collects a nickname and triggers a connection through TitleManager, managing button interactability and status text during the connect flow.

name: App.cs
summary: Central service locator and bootstrap singleton exposing all game managers, platform checks, scene state, and global scene-load events via nested static accessor classes.

name: AppHelper.cs
summary: MonoBehaviour bootstrap that persists across scenes, drives scene loading and frame-rate limiting, and bridges Unity scene callbacks into App's static events; also defines the generic Singleton base.

name: Enums.cs
summary: Central definition file for project-wide enums (scenes, UI types, finger/hand types, execution order, etc.) under the SystemEnums namespace, referenced across the entire codebase.

name: FrameChecker.cs
summary: On-screen FPS and millisecond-per-frame overlay rendered via OnGUI, with color-coded styling based on performance thresholds.

name: JsonHelper.cs
summary: Generic JSON (de)serialization helper wrapping Unity JsonUtility for arrays and providing async parsing into dictionaries, used by the data layer.

name: RpsHandUtility.cs
summary: Static utility encapsulating rock-paper-scissors judging rules and random finger-assignment/shuffle logic for game rounds.

name: HandSpriteDataGeneratorWindow.cs
summary: Unity Editor tool window that generates HandSpriteData ScriptableObjects from a dropped JSON definition, resolving sprites and creating output assets.

name: SceneFastLauncher.cs
summary: Unity Editor utility window for quickly opening project scenes from a drag-and-drop list, persisting the scene set in EditorPrefs.

name: CLAUDE.md
summary: Project guideline document instructing contributors and AI agents to avoid comments by default and keep any necessary comment to one short English line.

name: manifest.json
summary: Unity Package Manager manifest declaring the project's direct package dependencies and registry configuration.

name: packages-lock.json
summary: Unity Package Manager lockfile pinning resolved versions, sources, and dependency hashes for reproducible package restoration.
